test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7db5ef98cd5c95b612377af6779c4f3da528a12f8d20cac429fe9d0406654bbe.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The triangle is pointing in clockwise direction at each step and the alphabets are also moving in clockwise direction with one space gap.

 The alphabets after A are increasing and the alphabets after Z are decreasing.**

Next step will be:

** The triangle will face towards left. 

 The alphabet at top right will be D and the alphabet at bottom left will be W.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64ba70014f02b71b810a8f519cbcd0eef153ac253c98a11d3586f33b98fc9625.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) Face of triangle is pointing in wrong direction.

Option 2) The pattern is correct.

Option 3) The position of alphabets is wrong.

Option 4) Face of triangle is pointing in wrong direction and the position of alphabets is wrong.

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
